snippet.title: Flock Off! - Exclusive Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Flock Off! is a first-person action adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off zombified sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021550/Flock_Off/
